shortDescription: Manages applying ACLs to interfaces on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: acl_name
options.description: ACL number or name. For a numbered rule group, the value ranging from 2000 to 4999. For a named rule group, the value is a string of 1 to 32 case-sensitive characters starting with a letter, spaces not supported.

options.name: direction
options.description: Direction ACL to be applied in on the interface.

options.name: interface
options.description: Interface name. Only support interface full name, such as "40GE2/0/1".

options.name: state
options.description: Determines whether the config should be present or not on the device.
